class Customer(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'customer'
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    name = Column(String)
    credit_limit = Column(DECIMAL)
    balance = Column(DECIMAL)
models.description: Customer model including credit limit and balance.

class Order(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'order'
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    customer_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('customer.id'))
    amount_total = Column(DECIMAL)
    notes = Column(String)
    date_shipped = Column(Date)
models.description: Order model containing note field and shipped date.
models.name: Order

class Item(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'item'
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    order_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('order.id'))
    product_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('product.id'))
    quantity = Column(Integer)
    unit_price = Column(DECIMAL)
    amount = Column(DECIMAL)
models.description: Item model storing quantity, unit price, and total amount.
models.name: Item

class Product(Base):

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    name = Column(String)
    unit_price = Column(DECIMAL)

rules.name: Check Credit 1
rules.description: Customer balance should not exceed the credit limit.
rules.code: Rule.constraint(validate=Customer, as_condition=lambda row: row.balance <= row.credit_limit, error_msg="Customer balance ({row.balance}) exceeds credit limit (Row.credit_limit)")

rules.name: Check Credit 2
rules.description: Customer balance derived as sum of order amounts where shipped date is null.
rules.code: Rule.sum(derive=Customer.balance, as_sum_of=Order.amount_total, where=lambda row: row.date_shipped is None)

rules.description: Order total amount derived from sum of item amounts.

rules.description: Item amount derived from multiplication of quantity and unit price.

rules.description: Send Order to Kafka if date_shipped is not None.
rules.code: Rule.after_flush_row_event(on_class=Order, calling=kafka_producer.send_row_to_kafka, if_condition=lambda row: row.date_shipped is not None, with_args={"topic": "order_shipping"})
